note: Handwritten notes. The only data file meant to be edited by hand, and the only one no script ever rewrites. Everything here wins over the generated tiers, so this is where you overrule the site.
how: Key each entry by the id of the place you are overriding. Places found on the map look like 'osm-verve-coffe-roasters-74888--244326' and are stable across the weekly rebuild — but they are built from the name OSM carries, so if a misspelling there is ever corrected the id moves and the note is orphaned. The console says so when that happens.
Whatever you set replaces what was there, including 'title' — which is how a name the map has wrong gets written correctly here.
A 'why' is the useful one — it turns a name on a map into a recommendation, and marks it as somewhere you have actually been.
'HOMEGROUND_CITY=bay-area node scripts/draft.mjs <search terms>' finds a place and writes a filled-in stub.

'hide': true takes a place off every list — for somewhere you tried and would not send anyone. Give it a 'reason' so the next reader knows it was a verdict, not a mistake. Do not write a 'why' for these: a 'why' is a recommendation.

osm-verve-coffe-roasters-74888--244326.title: Verve Coffee Roasters
osm-verve-coffe-roasters-74888--244326.why: The patio is the reason to pick this one. Inside and out it is rarely quiet — students behind laptops, founders, people reading — and it runs seven to six every day, which makes it an afternoon place as much as a morning one.
osm-verve-coffe-roasters-74888--244326.imageSubject: A Verve coffee on the parklet bench
osm-verve-coffe-roasters-74888--244326.hoursFrom: the joe coffee listing; the note says the same

osm-goodthing-74890--244323.title: Goodthing Coffee
osm-goodthing-74890--244323.why: The upstairs loft is the draw — room to open a laptop and stay, which downtown Palo Alto is short of, and a patio underneath it. Order the Einspänner, black sesame or pistachio. The beans rotate through European roasters; Tanat was on when I was last in, and that is the one worth timing a visit for.
osm-goodthing-74890--244323.imageSubject: An iced coffee outside Goodthing Coffee
osm-goodthing-74890--244323.hoursFrom: the joe coffee listing; Yelp agrees

osm-salt-straw-74891--244324.title: Salt & Straw
osm-salt-straw-74891--244324.why: Order the Sea Salt with Caramel Ribbons. It was the first flavour they ever made: a salted ice cream with burnt caramel run through it, rather than a salted caramel. The line is long, but it moves, and it's worth the wait.

osm-ghirardelli-ice-cream-chocolate--756.title: Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop
osm-ghirardelli-ice-cream-chocolate--756.why: Chocolate that's hard to stop eating, with the bay in front of you. The shop is in Ghirardelli Square, the old chocolate factory above the water at the end of the Wharf, and Ghirardelli has made chocolate in San Francisco since 1852. Take a sundae or a bag of squares out onto the square and look across to Alcatraz.

osm-capital-one-360-cafe-75578--244808.title: Capital One Café
osm-capital-one-360-cafe-75578--244808.why: A calm place to work over a coffee, a block from Union Square on the corner of Post and Kearny. It's a bank that is mostly a café, with plenty of seating, free Wi-Fi and Peet's drinks made to order, and nobody minds you staying a while with a laptop, which is rare this close to Union Square.
osm-capital-one-360-cafe-75578--244808.hoursFrom: the Tripadvisor, SF Station and LiquidSpace listings

osm-namaste-74852--244290.title: Namaste Indian Cuisine
osm-namaste-74852--244290.why: Warm, everyday Indian on California Avenue: the paneer tikka masala, garlic naan and momos are the dishes people come back for. It is popular, so book at busy times.

osm-darbar-indian-cuisine-74890--244330.title: Darbar Indian Cuisine
osm-darbar-indian-cuisine-74890--244330.why: Downtown's long-running everyday Indian on Lytton, and the one for a quick, good-value lunch: the weekday buffet has about two dozen dishes that change daily, with plenty of naan. It is always busy at lunchtime.
osm-darbar-indian-cuisine-74890--244330.hoursFrom: openstreetmap, rewritten so a lunch cannot be lost to a dinner rule; Tripadvisor agrees

osm-ramen-nagi-74891--244321.title: Ramen Nagi
osm-ramen-nagi-74891--244321.why: The first American branch of a Tokyo ramen shop: you tick boxes on a card for broth richness, noodle firmness, garlic and spice. Get the Original King, a rich pork tonkotsu. The queue is the price, so arrive before it opens or late in the afternoon.

osm-onigilly-74889--244326.reason: Ordered in; didn't like the food much.

osm-original-ghirardelli-ice-cream-c-756.reason: The same shop as osm-ghirardelli-ice-cream-chocolate--75612--244845, mapped twice twelve metres apart; the note is on that one.

osm-tacolicious-74887--244322.reason: Closed for good on 31 October 2025 (SFGate); the map has not caught up.

osm-bevri-palo-alto-74891--244322.reason: Bevri's old address. It left 530 Bryant and now has only 335 University (bevri-palo-alto).
